result_summary.title: Critical: Data residency mismatch and retention failures in Sandbox (LATAM)
result_summary.description: In the LATAM sandbox environment, the Analytics Dashboard is showing data residency flag mismatches and failing to apply retention policies. This is a critical issue affecting over 13,000 users. We think it's because of insufficient capacity planning on the cluster causing these policy engines to drop tasks. Please prioritize capacity review.
